ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $\triangle OCA \cong \triangle OBD$ and $\angle A=30^\circ$, $\angle AOC=80^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle OCA \cong \triangle OBD$, $\angle A=30^\circ$, $\angle AOC=80^\circ$,
$\therefore \angle B=\angle C=180^\circ-\angle A-\angle AOC=180^\circ-30^\circ-80^\circ=\boxed{70^\circ}$.
